2d19b4b71e24e9f1a63408befd77fac589c4c8b7.why: Bilateral inferior lens dislocation and height above the 99th percentile are key findings that need to be grounded in evidence to differentiate between Marfan syndrome and other genetic disorders with marfanoid features.

evidence_chain.link: The presence of lens dislocation is a key feature of Marfan syndrome.
evidence_chain.quote: Eye and vision abnormalities, lens dislocation, severe myopia

evidence_chain.link: The presence of joint hypermobility and spontaneous subluxation is a key feature of Ehlers-Danlos syndrome.
evidence_chain.quote: Spontaneous subluxation was noted in all joints of the fingers and toes.

ranked_facts.why: The presence of bilateral inferior lens dislocation is a key feature of Marfan syndrome and Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, which are both genetic disorders that affect the body's connective tissue.
